mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact integral-kernel, Picard, flux, dimensional Poisson and certificate constants supporting the analytic self-gravitating exterior construction.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy rational functions and exact definite integrals with rational exponents; no floating arithmetic.
mathematics.conventions: n>3 is polytropic index; t=r/R0>=1; weighted norm sup t|Z|; mu uses central M0 and reference density at R0. The EOS constant (n+1)K is distinct from gauge length squared GM_Q/a0.

bounds.certificate_controls: n=4,5,6; mu/mu_star=1/4,1/2; exact critical endpoint mu=mu_star
bounds.gate_failure_control: n=7 exact upper-envelope limit at infinity
bounds.symbolic_controls: kernel primitives; first Picard derivative; inner flux; certificate derivative; dimensional source; Euler chemical identity; causal ratio factor
bounds.resource_cap: 30 second wall cap, 1 MiB log cap, cooperative one-thread library cap

non_claims: Finite controls do not replace the analytic uniform contraction proof.
No physical species identity, inner/core match, Einstein solution or coupled stability theorem.
Certificate threshold is not a nonexistence threshold for all Euler-Poisson equilibria.
